explanation: Zero at every GO and D2 step, and at most D1 steps; it jumps to about 9-10 only at the D1 step right after a trial that reached S2 and was rewarded (usually a common a2 trial, sometimes a rare a1 trial), and mostly when that is the first S2 reward of a run, meaning the trial before it was unrewarded or ended at S1. It is 0 again at the next D1 even if S2 keeps paying, it fires less often late in the episode (sometimes only about 6-8, or not at all), and any D1 after an S1 reward or after no reward is 0.
